actions: Read sanitized root control and evaluation role config at one frozen main SHA, then repeated SHA-only head lookup before semantic work.
Continued from role-local LATEST checkpoint only.
Reviewed primary/public literature on SeqE-Guard, horizon-aware anytime-valid testing, inverse McNemar sampling, and online e-closure/compound e-values.
Derived a two-level tail-floor candidate e-value G=m on an exact-binomial upper tail and G=c on its complement, with exact null expectation 1.

Proved a fixed-rejection-set log-wealth optimality reduction: commit states at m, noncommit states no larger than 1, uniform complement floor by Jensen; upper tail by monotone likelihood ratio/Neyman-Pearson.
Solved an approximate finite-horizon tail-choice Bellman recurrence for r=20 and stress-tested timing, effect strength, clustered proposals, and r=10/20/30/50 cost-power tradeoffs.
Enumerated all 15,504 placements of five improved candidates among 20 opportunities for timing robustness.
Persisted and read back the new checkpoint and updated role-local LATEST.

outputs.key_result: At r=20,q=.75,H=20 the tested horizon-spend tail-floor path used approximately k=17 for 15 surviving opportunities then k=16 for 5. Exact all-null false-commit probability was 0.047791; true-commit probability was 0.720700 for five improvements at positions 1-5, 0.711468 at 11-15, and 0.715344 for positions 5/10/15/20. Across all 15,504 five-of-20 placements, min/median/max true-commit were 0.711468/0.782379/0.913554.
outputs.clustered_stress: 100,000 latent proposal streams under the prior checkpoint's hot/cold process yielded P(any true commit)=0.856465 and P(any false commit)=0.002903 with mean 13.658 launched audits; audit outcome probabilities were integrated analytically conditional on each proposal stream.
outputs.scope: Finite-design/stylized power results only. Statistical validity still requires candidate freeze plus fresh conditionally valid audits; no claim that the q=.75 Bellman prior is operationally optimal.

termination.cause: scheduled invocation boundary after durable checkpoint/readback

operational_defect.description: An inert branch tmp-eval-noop was accidentally created at note main during tool routing. No commit or content was added to it; main and research state were unaffected. Current connector exposure had no branch-delete action, so cleanup was not possible in this invocation.

exact_next_action: Derive a least-favorable/minimax tail-floor policy for 20 opportunities with q_good in [0.60,0.80] and unknown placement of 1-5 improvements; compare worst-case true-commit probability and all-null FWER against fixed k17 and the 15xk17+5xk16 horizon-spend schedule, then jointly optimize discordant depth r under total paired-task and low-rho tail-cost constraints.
